01 / About me

Hi, I’m Shawn, a third-year Computer Engineering student at De La Salle University. I like projects where a circuit, a microcontroller, and a bit of code all have to agree with each other, and I learn fastest by wiring, soldering, debugging, and rebuilding.

I am aiming for a career in embedded systems and hardware design, where I can turn ideas into working prototypes and keep improving them. This portfolio shows the real boards, robots, and programs I have built along the way.

03 / Academic work: hardware

Reaction Time Counter

A hand-wired board that measures how quickly a person reacts and shows the result on a three-digit seven-segment display. It combines timing ICs, push buttons, and display drivers, and it taught me careful layout, soldering, and debugging dense wiring.

Digital logicSoldering7-segmentDebugging

MicroMouse: Object Avoider Robot

A two-wheel robot named MicroMouse that uses an ultrasonic sensor and a motor driver to detect obstacles and steer around them. I handled the wiring, power from an AA pack, and the control logic.

MicrocontrollerUltrasonic sensorMotor driverRobotics

AC to DC Power Supply

A bench-style power supply that steps mains voltage down with a transformer, then filters and regulates it into usable DC, with a potentiometer and LED indicators on the board. It deepened my understanding of rectification, filtering, and safe testing.

Power electronicsTransformerRegulationPerfboard

04 / Academic work: software

Manila Package Tracker

A desktop logistics app for tracking packages across a Manila delivery network. It has a dashboard with live status counts, an interactive network map of hubs, package management with search and status filters, plus hub management, incident reports, and analytics pages.

Dashboard UIMap integrationCRUDData tracking

Chess App with AI Opponent

A playable chess game against a computer opponent. It enforces legal moves, records the game in move notation, shows whose turn it is, and detects checkmate, as in the game on the left where the AI was beaten in four moves.

Game logicAI opponentMove validation

Airline Flight Reservation System

A C console program with a menu to check flight schedules, book a flight, cancel a booking, and print a booking receipt. Schedules list origin, destination, times, vacancy, and price in PHP.

CMenusData handlingFile logic
